claims.statement: For an exact-rank-three three-bank compression with one rank-two spectral bank and two rank-one banks whose compressed scalar-pair block B is invertible, the rank-one Schur remainder S has nonzero eigenvalue lambda_S satisfying |det B| |lambda_S| = mu, where mu is the complete aggregate principal-triple determinant mass across the three banks.

If the two rank-one-bank compressed scalar pair B is invertible indefinite with kappa=sigma_min(B)>0 and aggregate three-bank principal-determinant mass mu>0, then the full ambient quadratic form has an essentially bounded density with ||p_Q||_infinity <= 8*2^(3/4)*sqrt(5)*(kappa*mu)^(-1/4), uniformly in outside original-coordinate conditioning and affine terms.
Route or control the same aggregate three-bank state when the two rank-one-bank compressed pair is singular or has arbitrarily small sigma_min, without paying a reciprocal local physical minor.
